subject: How to change colors in box & whisker plots

messages.author: 96b171d2e941ddba
messages.subject: How to change colors in box & whisker plots
parts:
I want to change the definitions of the whiskers, following the method that was posted on stackoverflow:
------- 

geom_boxplot with stat_summary can do it:

# define the summary function
f <- function(x) {
  r <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95))
  names(r) <- c("ymin", "lower", "middle", "upper", "ymax")
  r
}

# sample data
d <- data.frame(x=gl(2,50), y=rnorm(100))

# do it
ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + stat_summary(fun.data = f, geom="boxplot")

# example with outliers
# define outlier as you want    
o <- function(x) {
  subset(x, x < quantile(x)[2] | quantile(x)[4] < x)
}

# do it
ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data=f, geom="boxplot") + 
  stat_summary(fun.y = o, geom="point")
----------

But everything is black. How do I set the colors for the box, whiskers and outliers using stat_summary?

Thanks,
Jim Rome

messages.author: 146c5031f31e4913
messages.subject: Re: How to change colors in box & whisker plots
parts:
Just like you would do with any of the geoms

ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) +
stat_summary(fun.data=f, geom="boxplot", colour = "blue", fill =
"green") +
stat_summary(fun.y = o, geom="point", colour = "red")
